title: Haman Hanged

questions.question: What did the king ask Esther on the second day of the feast?
options: What is your wish? It shall be granted you
questions.correctAnswer: What is your wish? It shall be granted you
questions.explanation: Esther 7:2 (ESV): "...What is your wish, Queen Esther? It shall be granted you..."

questions.question: What was Esther's request?
options: Let my life be granted me for my wish, and my people for my request
questions.correctAnswer: Let my life be granted me for my wish, and my people for my request
questions.explanation: Esther 7:3 (ESV): "...let my life be granted me for my wish, and my people for my request."

questions.question: How did Esther describe the fate of her people?
options: Sold, to be destroyed, to be killed, and to be annihilated
questions.correctAnswer: Sold, to be destroyed, to be killed, and to be annihilated
questions.explanation: Esther 7:4 (ESV): "For we have been sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be killed, and to be annihilated."

questions.question: Who did Esther identify as the adversary and enemy?
questions.explanation: Esther 7:6 (ESV): "And Esther said, 'A foe and enemy! This wicked Haman!'"

questions.question: How did Haman react when identified?
questions.explanation: Esther 7:6 (ESV): "Then Haman was terrified before the king and the queen."

questions.question: Where did the king go in his anger?
questions.explanation: Esther 7:7 (ESV): "And the king arose in his wrath from the wine-drinking and went into the palace garden..."

questions.question: What did Haman do while the king was gone?
options: Stayed to beg for his life from Queen Esther
questions.correctAnswer: Stayed to beg for his life from Queen Esther
questions.explanation: Esther 7:7 (ESV): "...but Haman stayed to beg for his life from Queen Esther..."

questions.question: What did the king see Haman doing when he returned?
options: Falling on the couch where Esther was
questions.correctAnswer: Falling on the couch where Esther was
questions.explanation: Esther 7:8 (ESV): "...Haman was falling on the couch where Esther was..."

questions.question: What did the king accuse Haman of doing?
questions.explanation: Esther 7:8 (ESV): "...Will he even assault the queen in my presence, in my own house?"

questions.question: Who pointed out the gallows Haman had made?
questions.explanation: Esther 7:9 (ESV): "Then Harbona, one of the eunuchs in attendance on the king, said..."

questions.question: How high were the gallows?
questions.explanation: Esther 7:9 (ESV): "...the gallows that Haman has prepared for Mordecai... fifty cubits high..."

questions.question: Who had Haman prepared the gallows for?
options: Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king
questions.correctAnswer: Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king
questions.explanation: Esther 7:9 (ESV): "...prepared for Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king..."

questions.question: What happened to Haman?
options: They hanged Haman on the gallows
questions.correctAnswer: They hanged Haman on the gallows
questions.explanation: Esther 7:10 (ESV): "So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai."

questions.question: What happened to the king's wrath after Haman was hanged?
questions.explanation: Esther 7:10 (ESV): "...Then the wrath of the king abated."

key_verse_text: For we have been sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be killed, and to be annihilated. If we had been sold merely as slaves, men and women, I would have been silent, for our affliction is not to be compared with the loss to the king.
